subject.title: 5.26 supervisor mode + dual-plist install: 30s EADDRINUSE loop + silent-fail unset order

question: What durable macOS launchd policy should OpenClaw use when gateway and node LaunchAgents both inject `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_LABEL` and the gateway wrapper sources that marker before exec?
rationale: The source-backed failure shape is plausible, but the permanent fix may change managed restart semantics, node-service availability, custom LaunchAgent labels, and doctor/install behavior for existing macOS users.

options.title: Docs-first plus live-proven hardening
options.body: Land or finish the docs mitigation, keep this issue open, then implement marker clearing and dual-plist doctor/install checks only after macOS launchd proof confirms the safe upgrade path.

options.title: Runtime wrapper hardening now
options.body: Change the generated gateway wrapper to clear launchd markers after sourcing the env file and update tests/docs, accepting that maintainers still need to define node LaunchAgent handling separately.

options.title: Preserve current marker semantics
options.body: Treat the dual-plist case as an operator configuration issue, document the manual workaround only, and avoid changing runtime or doctor behavior until broader macOS node-service policy is redesigned.

recommendation.title: Docs-first plus live-proven hardening
recommendation.body: Land or finish the docs mitigation, keep this issue open, then implement marker clearing and dual-plist doctor/install checks only after macOS launchd proof confirms the safe upgrade path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across daemon launchd, service env, and macOS operator-contract surfaces involved in this decision.
